name: CodeFlist Smart Product Review Lite For WooCommerce
author: CodeFlist

sections.description:
CodeFlist Smart Product Review Lite For WooCommerce is an All in One review pack for your WooCommerce store. It lets you add customers’ reviews and ratings with images and videos with ajax review submission and pagination.

  • Live Demo
  • Documentation

Features

  • Display customer reviews and ratings in Grid and List layouts.
  • 5 professionally designed templates for each layout.
  • Configurable number of columns for the Grid layout.
  • Show ratings on shop, category, archive, and other WooCommerce pages.
  • Display reviews in multiple positions on the single product page.
  • Review summary bar with customer image gallery and lightbox preview.

  • Advanced review sorting:

    • Most Recent
    • Highest Rating
    • Lowest Rating

  • Review filtering by:

    • Star Rating
    • Verified Buyers
    • Reviews with Images or Videos
  • Highly customizable review form with 5 different designs.
  • Review title support.
  • Rich text editor (WP Editor) for review content.
  • Image and video upload support.
  • Configure upload limits and allowed file sizes.
  • Enable or disable review form fields.
  • Google reCAPTCHA protection to reduce spam.
  • Restrict review submission to registered or verified customers.
  • Verified Buyer badge.

  • Admin review notification emails with:

    • Custom recipient email
    • Email title and subject
    • Logo support
    • Review details
    • Moderation links
    • Email preview before sending
  • Numeric and AJAX Load More pagination.
  • Lightbox for viewing review images and details.
  • Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • RTL (Right-to-Left) and LTR language support.
  • Translation ready.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce and most WordPress themes.

Pro Version

Upgrade to Pro to unlock even more powerful features.

  • Live Demo
  • Get Pro Version

Pro Features

Upgrade to the Pro version to unlock powerful review management and customer engagement features.

  • Display Reviews Anywhere

    • Grid, List, and Slider layouts.
    • 5 professionally designed templates for each layout.
    • Display reviews using an easy-to-use shortcode generator.

  • Review Reminder Emails

    • Automatically send review reminder emails after purchase.
    • Schedule reminder emails.
    • Send reminders for selected products or categories.
    • Include your logo and social media links.
    • Preview emails before sending.

  • Review Reward Coupons

    • Automatically send thank-you emails with coupons after approved reviews.
    • Configure coupon expiry time.
    • Reward only selected ratings.
    • Restrict rewards to verified or registered customers.
    • Target specific products or categories.
    • Include logo and social media links.
    • Preview emails before sending.

  • Rating Summary Bar

    • Display a rating summary bar on shop, archive, and product pages.

  • Advanced Review Sorting & Filtering

    • Sort by Most Recent, Most Relevant, Highest Rating, Lowest Rating, and Most Helpful.
    • Filter by star rating.
    • Filter verified customer reviews.
    • Filter reviews containing images or videos.

  • Advanced Review Form Builder

    • Add custom fields including:

    • Text

    • Textarea
    • Radio Buttons
    • Dropdown Select
    • Review title support.
    • Image and video uploads.
    • Rich text editor (WP Editor).
    • Configure upload limits and file sizes.
    • Enable or disable individual form fields.
    • Field validation.
    • GDPR consent checkbox.
    • Google reCAPTCHA protection.

  • Like & Dislike System

    • Allow customers to vote reviews as helpful or not helpful.

  • Shortcode Generator

    • Generate shortcodes to display review lists and review forms anywhere on your website.

  • Import & Export Reviews

    • Easily import or export WooCommerce reviews.

Privacy Notices

With the default configuration, this plugin does not:

  • track users
  • store personal data in the database
  • set cookies
  • send any data to external services

However, if certain optional features are enabled, data may be transmitted to third-party services.

External services

This plugin uses Google reCAPTCHA to protect forms from spam and automated abuse when the feature is enabled in the plugin settings.

It loads the Google reCAPTCHA script in the browser and sends a verification request to Google when a user submits a form protected by reCAPTCHA.

When this happens, the following data may be sent to Google:

  • reCAPTCHA response token (g-recaptcha-response)
  • User IP address (processed by Google)
  • Browser and interaction data collected by Google reCAPTCHA

sections.installation:
1.Upload the plugin to your WordPress site, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
2.Activate the plugin.
3.Go to Smart Product Review Lite in the WordPress admin menu.
4.Enable the settings you need and click Save Changes. You can also click Restore Default Settings to reset everything to the default configuration.
5.That’s it! Reviews will now be displayed on your product pages.
sections.faq:
A question that someone might have

An answer to that question.

Is there an option to add multiple images and videos while submitting the review?

Yes, the plugin allows the uploading of multiple images and videos by enabling the Image/videos settings from Review form settings tab.

Can you limit the number of images or videos users upload to the review?

Yes, the plugin allows you to limit the uploading number of images or videos to review.

Where can I moderate the reviews?

You can moderate the reviews from the WordPress Comment review page.

Does the plugin support WPML?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with the WPML plugin.

Is the plugin compatible with RTL?

Yes, the plugin supports RTL.

Can I only allow buyers to review our products?

Yes, the plugin has an option to only allow the buyer’s customer to review the products.

How can I prevent getting spam reviews?

You can enable reCaptcha in review form from the Recaptcha settings of the plugin.

  • Initial release.
